correctness.rationale: PASS: For fixed r and activities, exact singleton incidence probabilities a_i/sqrt(n)+O(n^-1), pair incidence probabilities a_i a_j/n+O(n^-3/2), and total probability of degree >=3 O(n^-1/2) give joint independent Gaussian singleton fluctuations and independent Poisson bridges by a multinomial triangular-array MGF. The hub component is a measurable function of the bridge counts, and the O_P(1) pair contribution to ordinary component size vanishes after n^1/4 scaling. Rare-cell Poisson coupling plus triple-event probability establishes O(n^-1/2) projected-graph TV. Rebuilt a three-hub finite incidence calculation conceptually and inspected verify.py; these regressions do not prove the limit.
